sources.text:

items.question: Do Thessaly Audio headphones come with replacement ear cushions?
items.answer: Headphones purchased directly from the Thessaly Audio online store include one free replacement set of ear cushions during the warranty period.

sources.title: Where to Buy and Product Registration - Thessaly Audio
sources.text:
Thessaly Audio products are sold through our online store and through authorised retailers listed on our Where to Buy page. Authorised retailers receive stock directly from Thessaly Audio, and many offer in-store demonstrations and fitting help for our earbuds.

We recommend registering your product in the Thessaly Connect app within a few weeks of purchase. Registration lets us tell you about firmware updates and safety notices for your model, and it stores your serial number so you do not have to look for it later. Registration is optional and is not required to make a warranty claim.

Be careful when buying from online marketplace sellers who are not listed on the Where to Buy page. We regularly find counterfeit Thessaly earbuds offered at steep discounts, often in packaging that looks very close to the real thing. You can check whether a product is genuine by entering its serial number in the Thessaly Connect app; genuine serial numbers begin with the letters TA followed by nine digits.

If you think you have bought a counterfeit product, contact the seller or marketplace first, and then send us the listing details so our brand protection team can investigate.

sources.title: Returning a Thessaly Audio Order
sources.text:
If you bought from the Thessaly Audio online store and changed your mind, you can return the product within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Return shipping is free for customers in the United States; we email a prepaid label once your return request is approved.

For hygiene reasons, earbuds and in-ear monitors can be returned only if the ear tips are unused and still sealed in their bag. Over-ear and on-ear headphones can be returned after being tried on, as long as the cushions are clean and undamaged.

Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days of the return reaching our warehouse. If you paid with a gift card, the refund is added back to the same card.

Products bought from an authorised retailer must be returned to that retailer under its own return policy. We are unable to accept returns or issue refunds for purchases made elsewhere, although the Thessaly Audio warranty still applies to products bought from authorised retailers.

sources.title: Thessaly Audio Limited Warranty
sources.text:
Thessaly Audio warrants its headphones, earbuds and portable speakers against defects in materials and workmanship for 2 years from the original date of purchase. The warranty applies to the original purchaser and requires proof of purchase, such as an order confirmation or a dated receipt.

Headphones purchased directly from the Thessaly Audio online store include one free replacement set of ear cushions during the warranty period. To request your cushions, open a support ticket with your order number and the model name, and we will post them to the shipping address on the order.

Rechargeable batteries are covered against manufacturing defects for the full warranty period. Some loss of battery capacity with normal use is expected and is not treated as a defect unless capacity falls below 70 percent of the original rating within the first 12 months.

This warranty does not cover damage caused by drops, crushing, liquid exposure beyond the product's stated water-resistance rating, or repairs carried out by anyone other than Thessaly Audio or an authorised service partner. Cosmetic wear such as scratches, scuffs and fading is also excluded.

If we confirm a covered defect, we will repair the product or replace it with the same or an equivalent model, at our discretion. Replacement products are covered for the remainder of the original warranty period or 90 days, whichever is longer.

sources.title: Holiday Returns 2026 - Ostara Kitchenworks
sources.text:
To give you more time with gifts, Ostara Kitchenworks is extending its return window for the holiday season. Orders delivered between November 1 and December 31, 2026 qualify for an extended return window of 60 days from delivery.

The extended window covers cookware, bakeware, cutlery, small appliances and kitchen textiles. Items must be unused and returned in their original packaging, including any inserts and protective sleeves. Knives that have been sharpened by anyone other than Ostara Kitchenworks cannot be returned.

Engraved and monogrammed items are final sale and are not eligible for return at any time of year. Clearance items marked Final Sale on the product page are also excluded from the holiday extension.

Gift recipients can start a return with the gift receipt code printed on the packing slip. Refunds for gift returns are issued as an Ostara Kitchenworks e-gift card in the recipient's name, and the original purchaser is not notified.

Once your return reaches our warehouse, please allow up to 10 business days for it to be inspected and refunded. During January, inspection can take a few days longer because of seasonal volume.

sources.title: Holiday Shipping Deadlines - Ostara Kitchenworks
sources.text:
Want your Ostara Kitchenworks order to arrive by December 24? Use the dates below as a guide for addresses in the contiguous United States.

Standard shipping: order by December 14.
Two-Day shipping: order by December 19 before noon Eastern time.
Overnight shipping: order by December 22 before noon Eastern time.

Cast-iron and enamelled Dutch ovens ship from a separate warehouse and may arrive in their own box a day or two after the rest of your order. Orders that include engraving need an extra 3 business days before they ship, so please place them by December 9 if you are using Standard shipping.

Our warehouse is closed on December 25 and January 1, and orders placed on those days ship on the next business day. Carriers sometimes miss their delivery estimates during the busiest weeks of the season, and we are unable to guarantee arrival dates for any shipping method.

sources.title: Price Adjustments - Ostara Kitchenworks
sources.text:
If an item you bought from Ostara Kitchenworks goes down in price within 14 days of delivery, we will refund the difference. Contact our support team with your order number and a link to the product page showing the lower price. Price adjustments are made to the original payment method.

Price adjustments are available once per item and only for the same product, colour and size. They do not apply to prices offered by other retailers, to limited-quantity doorbuster deals, or to bundle discounts where the item was sold as part of a set.

If you have already returned the item, or if the lower price required a promotional code that has since expired, we cannot adjust the price. Price adjustments for gift purchases are made to the original purchaser, not the gift recipient, so the recipient's gift receipt is not affected.

items.answer: Starting March 2, 2026, the replacement item ships free of charge when the exchange is requested through the online Returns Center.

sources.title: Size and Fit Guide - Wrenfield Apparel
sources.text:
Wrenfield Apparel sizes run true to size for most customers. Each product page lists garment measurements in both inches and centimetres, taken with the item laid flat.

To find your size, measure your chest at the fullest point, your natural waist, and your hips at the widest point, keeping the tape snug but not tight. Compare these numbers with the body measurements chart on the product page rather than with clothes you already own, since fits vary between brands.

Our merino and lambswool knitwear relaxes slightly with wear, so if you are between sizes for a sweater, we suggest choosing the smaller size. Our cotton denim has about 2 percent stretch and keeps its shape, so choose your usual size. Outerwear is cut with room for a mid-weight layer underneath.

Still unsure? Our Fit Advisors can help by live chat from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. Eastern time, seven days a week. Tell them your height, usual size and how you like your clothes to fit, and they will recommend a size for the item you are looking at.

sources.title: Exchanges - Wrenfield Apparel
sources.text:
Need a different size or colour? Wrenfield Apparel allows one exchange per item for another size or colour of the same style. You can request an exchange through the online Returns Center, in any Wrenfield store, or by calling Customer Care.

Starting March 2, 2026, the replacement item ships free of charge when the exchange is requested through the online Returns Center. Before that date, all exchange replacements were charged standard shipping.

When you submit an exchange request online, we reserve the replacement straight away and ship it as soon as the carrier scans your returning parcel. Store exchanges are completed on the spot if the store has your size in stock.

Items must be unworn and unwashed, with the original tags still attached. Exchanges are only available for items of equal price. If you would like a different style, please return the original item for a refund and place a new order. Items marked Final Sale cannot be exchanged.

If the size or colour you want sells out before your request is submitted, the Returns Center will offer you a refund instead.

sources.title: Changing or Cancelling an Order - Wrenfield Apparel
sources.text:
You can change or cancel a Wrenfield Apparel order for up to 60 minutes after you place it. Go to Order History in your account and choose Edit Order; you can change sizes, colours, quantities and the delivery address during this time.

After 60 minutes your order is sent to our fulfilment centre and can no longer be edited. If you still need a different size, you can request an exchange once the order arrives. If you no longer want the order, you can refuse the delivery or send it back after it arrives.

Orders paid with a buy-now-pay-later provider are cancelled through that provider's app as well as in your Wrenfield account, and the provider will update your payment plan within 2 business days.

Gift wrapping and gift messages can be added or removed during the 60-minute editing window but not afterwards. Personalised items, such as monogrammed scarves, cannot be cancelled once the order is placed.

Need a different size or colour? Wrenfield Apparel allows one exchange per item for another size or colour of the same style. You can request an exchange through the online Returns Center, in any Wrenfield store, or by calling Customer Care.

Starting March 2, 2026, the replacement item ships free of charge when the exchange is requested through the online Returns Center. Before that date, all exchange replacements were charged standard shipping.

When you submit an exchange request online, we reserve the replacement straight away and ship it as soon as the carrier scans your returning parcel. Store exchanges are completed on the spot if the store has your size in stock.

Items must be unworn and unwashed, with the original tags still attached. Exchanges are only available for items of equal price. If you would like a different style, please return the original item for a refund and place a new order. Items marked Final Sale cannot be exchanged.

If the size or colour you want sells out before your request is submitted, the Returns Center will offer you a refund instead.

sources.title: Changing or Cancelling an Order - Wrenfield Apparel
sources.text:
You can change or cancel a Wrenfield Apparel order for up to 60 minutes after you place it. Go to Order History in your account and choose Edit Order; you can change sizes, colours, quantities and the delivery address during this time.

After 60 minutes your order is sent to our fulfilment centre and can no longer be edited. If you still need a different size, you can request an exchange once the order arrives. If you no longer want the order, you can refuse the delivery or send it back after it arrives.

Orders paid with a buy-now-pay-later provider are cancelled through that provider's app as well as in your Wrenfield account, and the provider will update your payment plan within 2 business days.

Gift wrapping and gift messages can be added or removed during the 60-minute editing window but not afterwards. Personalised items, such as monogrammed scarves, cannot be cancelled once the order is placed.

sources.title: Damaged or Broken Items - Lumivane Lighting
sources.text:
Every Lumivane shade is packed in a double-walled carton with moulded pulp inserts, but breakages occasionally happen in transit. If your lamp, shade or bulb arrives damaged, please let us know within 7 days of delivery.

sources.title: International Shipping - Lumivane Lighting
sources.text:

items.answer: Appliances registered online between April 1 and September 30, 2026 receive a second year of parts and labour coverage at no extra cost.

sources.title: Fennick Appliance Limited Warranty
sources.text:
Every new Fennick refrigerator, range, dishwasher, washer and dryer comes with a 1-year limited warranty covering parts and labour from the date of delivery. During this period, Fennick or an authorised service partner will repair defects in materials or workmanship at no charge.

The sealed refrigeration system on refrigerators and freezers is covered for parts for 5 years. The sealed system includes the compressor, condenser, evaporator, drier and connecting tubing. Labour for sealed-system repairs after the first year is charged at the service partner's standard rate.

2026 Registration Bonus
Appliances registered online between April 1 and September 30, 2026 receive a second year of parts and labour coverage at no extra cost. To register, you will need the model and serial numbers from the rating label, which is usually found inside the door or on the back panel.

The limited warranty covers appliances used for normal household purposes in the United States and Canada. It does not cover commercial use, damage from improper installation, power surges, or cosmetic damage reported more than 30 days after delivery. Replacement water filters and light bulbs are consumable parts and are not covered.

sources.title: Fennick Protection Plus Service Plans
sources.text:
Fennick Protection Plus is an optional service plan that you can buy for any Fennick appliance at any time while its original limited warranty is still active. Plans are available in 3-year and 5-year terms, and each term begins on the day the plan is purchased.

Protection Plus covers mechanical and electrical failures from normal use, including parts, labour and the technician's travel charge. It also covers food spoilage of up to $250 per claim if a covered refrigerator or freezer failure causes food to be thrown away, as long as you provide receipts or a written list of the items.

Plans are priced by appliance type. A 3-year plan for a dishwasher costs $129, and a 5-year plan for a refrigerator costs $289. Prices include all taxes where taxes apply.

You can cancel Protection Plus within 30 days of purchase for a full refund. After 30 days, cancellations receive a prorated refund minus any claims paid. Protection Plus is a separate contract from the Fennick limited warranty and has its own terms and conditions.

sources.title: Requesting Warranty Service - Fennick Appliances
sources.text:
If your Fennick appliance stops working as it should, start a service request online or call our appliance support line. Have the model and serial numbers ready, along with the date of delivery and a short description of the problem.

Before booking a technician, our support team will walk you through a few quick checks. Many reported faults, such as a dishwasher that will not start or a dryer that runs cold, turn out to be a tripped breaker, a child lock, or a blocked vent, and can be fixed in minutes.

If a technician visit is needed, an authorised service partner will contact you to arrange a time. Please make sure the appliance is accessible, with at least 60 cm of clear space in front of it, and that an adult is home for the visit. Built-in appliances must be removable from their cabinetry without damaging it.

Service is available in the United States and Canada only. In some rural areas the nearest service partner may be more than 100 miles away; in these cases we may arrange a mail-in repair for smaller items or send a replacement part that you can fit yourself with video guidance.

standalone.question: How are gift returns refunded at Ostara Kitchenworks? Please cite your source.
standalone.answer: Gift returns are refunded as an Ostara Kitchenworks e-gift card in the recipient's name [S3].

sources.title: Holiday Returns 2026 - Ostara Kitchenworks
sources.text:
To give you more time with gifts, Ostara Kitchenworks is extending its return window for the holiday season. Orders delivered between November 1 and December 31, 2026 qualify for an extended return window of 60 days from delivery.

The extended window covers cookware, bakeware, cutlery, small appliances and kitchen textiles. Items must be unused and returned in their original packaging, including any inserts and protective sleeves. Knives that have been sharpened by anyone other than Ostara Kitchenworks cannot be returned.

Engraved and monogrammed items are final sale and are not eligible for return at any time of year. Clearance items marked Final Sale on the product page are also excluded from the holiday extension.

Gift recipients can start a return with the gift receipt code printed on the packing slip. Refunds for gift returns are issued as an Ostara Kitchenworks e-gift card in the recipient's name, and the original purchaser is not notified.

Once your return reaches our warehouse, please allow up to 10 business days for it to be inspected and refunded. During January, inspection can take a few days longer because of seasonal volume.

sources.title: Holiday Shipping Deadlines - Ostara Kitchenworks
sources.text:
Want your Ostara Kitchenworks order to arrive by December 24? Use the dates below as a guide for addresses in the contiguous United States.

Standard shipping: order by December 14.
Two-Day shipping: order by December 19 before noon Eastern time.
Overnight shipping: order by December 22 before noon Eastern time.

Cast-iron and enamelled Dutch ovens ship from a separate warehouse and may arrive in their own box a day or two after the rest of your order. Orders that include engraving need an extra 3 business days before they ship, so please place them by December 9 if you are using Standard shipping.

Our warehouse is closed on December 25 and January 1, and orders placed on those days ship on the next business day. Carriers sometimes miss their delivery estimates during the busiest weeks of the season, and we are unable to guarantee arrival dates for any shipping method.

sources.title: Price Adjustments - Ostara Kitchenworks
sources.text:
If an item you bought from Ostara Kitchenworks goes down in price within 14 days of delivery, we will refund the difference. Contact our support team with your order number and a link to the product page showing the lower price. Price adjustments are made to the original payment method.

Price adjustments are available once per item and only for the same product, colour and size. They do not apply to prices offered by other retailers, to limited-quantity doorbuster deals, or to bundle discounts where the item was sold as part of a set.

If you have already returned the item, or if the lower price required a promotional code that has since expired, we cannot adjust the price. Price adjustments for gift purchases are made to the original purchaser, not the gift recipient, so the recipient's gift receipt is not affected.

sources.text:
The Halden X2 is a compact 1080p projector designed for movie nights at home and presentations on the go. It weighs 1.4 kg and runs for up to 3 hours on its built-in battery, enough for most feature films.

The X2 projects images from 40 to 120 inches diagonally and includes automatic keystone correction and autofocus, so it can be set up on a coffee table or bookshelf without a tripod. Brightness is rated at 600 ANSI lumens, so it performs best in a dim room.

Connections include HDMI, USB-C with video input, and Bluetooth for external speakers. A built-in 8-watt speaker handles dialogue in smaller rooms, and the projector's streaming apps are updated over Wi-Fi.

In the box you will find the projector, a remote control with batteries, a 65-watt USB-C charger, a carrying pouch and a quick start guide. The Halden X2 is covered by a 1-year manufacturer warranty. Replacement remotes and pouches can be ordered from the accessories page.

sources.text:
Brackwater Electronics accepts returns of most products within 30 days of delivery. Unopened products in their original sealed packaging are refunded in full.

Opened projectors, cameras, drones and VR headsets can be returned within the same 30-day window, but a restocking fee of 15 percent of the item's purchase price is deducted from the refund. sources.text:
Vantor spare and original e-bike batteries are covered by a 2-year limited warranty from the date of delivery. A battery is considered defective if it fails to hold a charge, shows a cell imbalance error, or loses more than 40 percent of its rated capacity within the warranty period.

To make a claim, connect the battery to the Vantor Ride app and run the battery health report, then send the report to our support team along with your order number. In most cases we can confirm a defect from the report alone, without the battery being sent back.

Batteries that are swollen, punctured or have been in a crash must not be shipped; take them to a local battery recycling point instead and send us a photo of the drop-off receipt.

The warranty does not cover damage from water immersion, charging with a non-Vantor charger, or storing the battery fully discharged for long periods.

sources.title: Shipping E-Bikes and Spare Batteries - Vantor Cycles
sources.text:
Vantor Cycles ships complete e-bikes and spare batteries from our assembly centre in Tacoma, Washington. E-bikes arrive 90 percent assembled; you will need to attach the handlebars, pedals and front wheel using the tools in the box.

You can choose Ground or Express shipping for any order at checkout. Express shipping sends your order by air for delivery in 2 business days; however, spare batteries are never shipped by air and always travel by ground, regardless of the shipping method selected, because of lithium-ion transport rules. Choosing Express for a battery-only order shortens handling time at our warehouse but does not change how the battery travels.

Batteries are shipped at a partial charge of about 30 percent, as required for transport. Charge the battery fully before your first ride.

We cannot ship spare batteries to Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico or P.O. boxes, because those routes would require air transport. Complete e-bikes can be shipped to Alaska and Hawaii by ocean freight, which takes 3 to 5 weeks.

In-Home Setup deliveries are scheduled by phone and usually take place within 2 weeks of your order.

standalone.question: What warranty comes with the Tarnfield Ember 30 air fryer?
standalone.answer: The Ember 30 air fryer is covered by Tarnfield's 5-year limited warranty.

sources.title: Ember 30 Air Fryer - Tarnfield Kitchen
sources.text:
The Ember 30 is a 3-litre air fryer sized for one or two people. It shares its 1,500-watt heating element and digital control board with the Tarnfield Pro Ember 40, in a smaller housing that fits under most kitchen cabinets.

Eight presets cover fries, chicken, fish, vegetables, reheating, baking, dehydrating and keep-warm. The basket and crisper plate have a non-stick ceramic coating and are dishwasher safe.

The Ember 30 reaches 200 degrees Celsius and switches off automatically when the basket is removed. A viewing window lets you check on food without opening the drawer, and a shake reminder sounds halfway through presets that need it.

In the box: air fryer, basket, crisper plate, recipe booklet and user manual. Replacement baskets and crisper plates are sold separately on the accessories page.

sources.title: Tarnfield Pro Warranty
sources.text:
All Tarnfield Pro appliances carry a 5-year limited warranty covering parts and labour from the date of purchase. The Pro line is built with commercial-grade motors and stainless steel housings, and Pro appliances are identified by the Pro badge on the front panel and the letters TP at the start of the model number.

The warranty requires proof of purchase and covers defects in materials and workmanship under normal household use.

To make a claim, register your appliance on the Tarnfield website and describe the fault. For motor and heating faults, we usually ask for a short video showing the problem. If a repair is not practical, we will replace the appliance with the same model or, if it has been discontinued, a model of equal or greater value.

The warranty does not cover glass jugs, filters, gaskets or other wear parts after the first 12 months, or damage caused by using the appliance with a voltage converter.

sources.title: Cleaning Your Air Fryer - Tarnfield Kitchen
sources.text:
Clean your Tarnfield air fryer after every use to stop grease from building up and smoking at high temperatures. Unplug the appliance and let it cool for at least 30 minutes before you start.

The basket and crisper plate can go in the dishwasher on a normal cycle, or you can wash them by hand with warm soapy water and a soft sponge. Do not use metal scourers or abrasive powders, which can scratch the non-stick coating.

Wipe the inside of the drawer housing with a damp cloth. If food has splashed onto the heating element, brush it off gently with a soft, dry brush once the element is completely cool. Never immerse the main unit in water.

If your air fryer produces white smoke, it is usually fat from fatty foods collecting in the drawer; add a tablespoon of water to the drawer before cooking to reduce it. Black smoke can mean food is touching the element, and you should switch the appliance off and unplug it.

standalone.question: How long do I have to return unworn shoes to Quillon Footwear?

Returns from gift orders are refunded as a Quillon gift card so the gift-giver is not notified. If you have any trouble printing the label, our support team can send you a QR code to use at the drop-off counter instead.

Return shipping within the United States costs $6, which is deducted from your refund. Exchanges for a different size are free of charge.

standalone.question: How long are sealed-system parts covered on a Fennick refrigerator? Please cite your source.
standalone.answer: Parts for the sealed refrigeration system in Fennick refrigerators and freezers are covered for 5 years [S2].

sources.title: Fennick Appliance Limited Warranty
sources.text:
Every new Fennick refrigerator, range, dishwasher, washer and dryer comes with a 1-year limited warranty covering parts and labour from the date of delivery. During this period, Fennick or an authorised service partner will repair defects in materials or workmanship at no charge.

The sealed refrigeration system on refrigerators and freezers is covered for parts for 5 years. The sealed system includes the compressor, condenser, evaporator, drier and connecting tubing. Labour for sealed-system repairs after the first year is charged at the service partner's standard rate.

2026 Registration Bonus
Appliances registered online between April 1 and September 30, 2026 receive a second year of parts and labour coverage at no extra cost. To register, you will need the model and serial numbers from the rating label, which is usually found inside the door or on the back panel.

The limited warranty covers appliances used for normal household purposes in the United States and Canada. It does not cover commercial use, damage from improper installation, power surges, or cosmetic damage reported more than 30 days after delivery. Replacement water filters and light bulbs are consumable parts and are not covered.

sources.title: Fennick Protection Plus Service Plans
sources.text:
Fennick Protection Plus is an optional service plan that you can buy for any Fennick appliance at any time while its original limited warranty is still active. Plans are available in 3-year and 5-year terms, and each term begins on the day the plan is purchased.

Protection Plus covers mechanical and electrical failures from normal use, including parts, labour and the technician's travel charge. It also covers food spoilage of up to $250 per claim if a covered refrigerator or freezer failure causes food to be thrown away, as long as you provide receipts or a written list of the items.

Plans are priced by appliance type. A 3-year plan for a dishwasher costs $129, and a 5-year plan for a refrigerator costs $289. Prices include all taxes where taxes apply.

You can cancel Protection Plus within 30 days of purchase for a full refund. After 30 days, cancellations receive a prorated refund minus any claims paid. Protection Plus is a separate contract from the Fennick limited warranty and has its own terms and conditions.

sources.title: Requesting Warranty Service - Fennick Appliances
sources.text:
If your Fennick appliance stops working as it should, start a service request online or call our appliance support line. Have the model and serial numbers ready, along with the date of delivery and a short description of the problem.

Before booking a technician, our support team will walk you through a few quick checks. Many reported faults, such as a dishwasher that will not start or a dryer that runs cold, turn out to be a tripped breaker, a child lock, or a blocked vent, and can be fixed in minutes.

If a technician visit is needed, an authorised service partner will contact you to arrange a time. Please make sure the appliance is accessible, with at least 60 cm of clear space in front of it, and that an adult is home for the visit. Built-in appliances must be removable from their cabinetry without damaging it.

Service is available in the United States and Canada only. In some rural areas the nearest service partner may be more than 100 miles away; in these cases we may arrange a mail-in repair for smaller items or send a replacement part that you can fit yourself with video guidance.

standalone.question: How much VAT will Lumivane pay on my $300 Express International order to London?
standalone.answer: On a $300 Express International order shipped to the United Kingdom, Lumivane pays $60 in VAT.

sources.title: Damaged or Broken Items - Lumivane Lighting
sources.text:
Every Lumivane shade is packed in a double-walled carton with moulded pulp inserts, but breakages occasionally happen in transit. If your lamp, shade or bulb arrives damaged, please let us know within 7 days of delivery.

To report damage, reply to your shipping confirmation email with your order number and photos of the damaged item, the inside of the box and the shipping label. Keep all the packaging until your claim is settled, because the carrier may ask to inspect it.

Once we receive your photos, we will send a replacement at no cost, usually within 3 business days. If the item is no longer in stock, we will refund the full price of the item, including any shipping you paid for it. You do not need to send the broken item back unless we specifically ask you to.

For international orders, replacements are sent by the same service as the original order and can take just as long to arrive. Please do not refuse an international parcel because the outer carton looks damaged; accept it, check the contents, and report any breakage to us.

sources.title: Shipping Within the United States - Lumivane Lighting
sources.text:
Lumivane Lighting ships to all 50 states from our warehouse in Ohio. Orders placed before 1 p.m. Eastern time on a business day usually leave the warehouse the same day.

Standard shipping takes 3 to 6 business days and is free on orders of $99 or more. Below $99, Standard shipping is a flat $8. Two-Day shipping is available for $22 to addresses in the contiguous United States.

Floor lamps and large pendant lights ship in oversized cartons and travel by ground freight. These orders cannot be upgraded to Two-Day shipping, and delivery to Alaska and Hawaii can take up to 14 business days.

We ship to P.O. boxes using the postal service, but oversized cartons cannot be delivered to a P.O. box. If your order contains an oversized item, please use a street address. Military APO and FPO addresses are supported for bulbs, shades and table lamps only.

sources.title: International Shipping - Lumivane Lighting
sources.text:
Lumivane Lighting ships lamps, shades and bulbs to 31 countries from our warehouse in Ohio. At checkout, international customers can choose between two services.

Economy International is delivered by postal partners and usually arrives in 8 to 15 business days. Economy International orders are shipped duties-unpaid to every destination, which means the recipient pays any import duties, taxes and carrier handling fees before the parcel is released.

Express International is delivered by courier with full tracking and usually arrives in 3 to 5 business days. For Express International orders shipped to the United Kingdom, Lumivane pays the import duties and VAT on your behalf, so nothing further is due on delivery. Express International rates are calculated at checkout from the parcel's weight and dimensions.

Glass shades over 50 cm in diameter can only be sent by Express International because of the risk of breakage in postal networks. Bulbs containing mercury, including compact fluorescent bulbs, cannot be shipped outside the United States.

We cannot change the shipping address once an international order has been handed to the carrier. Please double-check your postcode and include a phone number, as couriers in many countries need one to contact you about customs.

You can also request up to three free deluxe samples with any order over $35. Samples are chosen at checkout from the list shown in your bag, and availability changes weekly. Foundation samples come in single-use sachets so you can test a shade for a full day before buying the full size.

Members of Juniper Lane Rewards earn 1 point for every dollar spent and can redeem 500 points for a $10 reward. Points are deducted if an order is refunded, and rewards cannot be used toward gift cards.

Our skincare consultants can also recommend a routine based on your skin type and concerns. Consultations take place by chat or video call, are free, and can be booked for any day of the week.

Opened skincare and makeup can be returned for a full refund within 30 days of delivery, but only if at least half of the product remains and only for one opened item per account in any 12-month period. If a shade or formula turns out not to suit you, our shade-matching chat can help you find a better match for next time.

Fragrances can be returned only if the cellophane wrap is unbroken. Hair tools such as dryers and straighteners can be returned within 30 days if they have been used no more than twice, and they must be sent back with all attachments.

Gift sets are returned as a whole; we cannot accept part of a set. Products marked as samples or travel minis that came free with an order do not need to be returned and do not affect your refund.
